blocks.text: The post-cold war world is a very different place. Power is moving from
Western countries to other areas of the world. Global politics, as a result, has
become more complex, involving countries from many civilizations. In this new
world, both differences and similarities in culture determine partners and
enemies. These factors have caused political and economic differences among
countries. Moreover, these differences often cause local conflicts to grow into
